A '''Smuggler Camp''' on [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]] was used by the [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Ewrosa Soci]]. It was a secret landing site for transport [[Starship/Legends|ships]] that smuggled [[Spice/Legends|spice]] to the jungle [[Moon/Legends|moon]] that Soci sold to local workers.

Crates and containers were stacked on the ground around the landing site. A group of [[Jawa/Legends|Jawas]] were helping the smugglers.

In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]] a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] sent by [[Osae Meilea]] attacked the camp and killed many of Soci's smugglers. The Jawas weren't harmed in the fight. The spacer then took Soci's shipment of spice and brought it to Soci as proof that his spice smuggling operation had been destroyed.<ref name="SWG:CaFS" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Smuggler Camp was a location in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]].<ref name="SWG:CaFS" /> The game was shut down on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The Smuggler Camp was added to the game with the questline "[[:w:c:swg:Catch A Fallen Star|Catch A Fallen Star]]" released with the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 21 Notes for 4 August 2005|Publish 21]]," on [[August 4]], [[2005]].<ref name="SonyCite-Publish Archive 2005">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=64886&resource=publish|text=Publish Archive 2005}}</ref> During this mission, the player had to attack smugglers at the camp until he found the shipment of [[Spice/Legends|spice]].<ref name="SWG:CaFS" />

Besides several smugglers that could be attacked and killed, there was also a group of Jawas at the camp who could not be attacked.<ref name="SWG:CaFS" />
